author: Diego Sandoval
title: Corey Seager (mild concussion symptoms) absent from lineup Sunday
desc: Corey Seager is not in the starting lineup for Sunday's matchup with the Red Sox.
impact: Seager has been out for the entire weekend series against Boston after a collision with Kansas City catcher Carter Jansen on Thursday. The shortstop's concussion symptoms are reportedly mild, so he could make his return in the coming days.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Kyle Teel (hamstring) to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Kyle Teel will begin his rehab assignment on Tuesday at Triple-A Charlotte, according to manager Will Venable.
impact: Teel has been on the injured list for the entire season, but is inching closer to his 2026 debut. The catcher slashed .273/.375/.411 with eight homers and 35 RBI in 78 games last season.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Noah Schultz (knee) to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: White Sox manager Will Venable announced that lefthander Noah Schultz will begin his rehab assignment on Tuesday at Triple-A Charlotte.
impact: Schultz has been on the injured list with a knee injury since May 26th and will now take one step closer to a return by beginning a rehab assignment. It is unknown how many starts the lefty will need before being elevated to the MLB club.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Cooper Pratt to be called up by Brewers
desc: Brewers No. 4-ranked prospect Cooper Pratt is being called up to the big-league club.
impact: Pratt was pulled from Sunday's game in Triple-A Nashville, and it was confirmed that he will be heading to Milwaukee. The shortstop has slashed .241/.349/.386 with six homers and 17 stolen bases in 58 games at the Triple-A level this season. Pratt should get plenty of opportunity to carve out a role going forward.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Grayson Rodriguez leaves Sunday's start early
desc: Angels starter Grayson Rodriguez left Sunday's start against the Rays in the third inning with an apparent injury.
impact: Rodriguez loaded the bases in the third inning before meeting with a trainer and being removed from the game. The nature and extent of the injury are currently unknown.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Naylor (shin) has X-rays return negative
desc: Josh Naylor had X-rays return negative on his shin injury.
impact: Naylor left early on Sunday with the injury. He is day-to-day heading into Monday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andres Munoz exits early Sunday with back injury
desc: Andres Munoz left Sunday's game early with back tightness.
impact: Munoz was pitching for the first time in close to a week. He will continue to be further evaluated.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: J.P Crawford (hand) expects to be activated Tuesday
desc: Mariners infielder J.P. Crawford said he expects to be activated from the injured list on Tuesday, when first eligible.
impact: Crawford told the media he expects to be activated before Tuesday's series opener against the Orioles. Additionally, with Colt Emerson surging as a rookie at shortstop, Crawford has been exclusively taking ground balls at third base while traveling with the team on their current road trip. He hit .228 with 10 homers and a stolen base in 55 games before hitting the shelf.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Griffin Jax dealing with minor blister issue
desc: Rays right-hander Griffin Jax is dealing with a minor blister issue as he stretches out from a reliever to a starter.
impact: Jax said throwing more pitches is causing some irritation, but said, "we are doing a good job staying on top of it." It doesn't sound like Jax is in danger of missing time with the blister issue, but it could be something to monitor as he continues to fully stretch out as a starter.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Sam Haggerty signs minors deal with Reds
desc: The Reds have signed outfielder Sam Haggerty to a minor-league deal and have assigned him to Triple-A Louisville.
impact: Haggerty was recently designated for assignment by the Rangers before being officially released by the club last Sunday. The veteran has appeared in 302 big league games, hitting .232 with 11 homers, 101 runs, and 47 stolen bases between the Mets, Mariners, and Rangers in that time.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Gavin Williams to start Wednesday versus Brewers
desc: Guardians right-hander Gavin Williams will start Wednesday in Milwaukee after Sunday's contest against the Tigers was postponed.
impact: Williams was looking to help the Guardians to a sweep of the Tigers on Sunday, but will instead get the ball for game two of a three-game set in Milwaukee against the Brewers on Wednesday. Williams owns a 3.32 ERA with 99 strikeouts across 14 starts and 86 2/3 innings this season.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Casey Mize (groin) to start Wednesday versus Astros
desc: Tigers right-hander Casey Mize (groin) is expected to be activated to start Wednesday's game in Houston.
impact: Mize was initially scheduled to come off the injured list to start Sunday's series finale in Cleveland, but a postponement has thrown a wrench into those plans. The Tigers have opted to keep right-hander Troy Melton and left-hander Framber Valdez on regular rest to start the first two games of the series before Mize is activated to start on Wednesday in Houston against the Astros.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Seiya Suzuki (knee) scratched from lineup Sunday
desc: Seiya Suzuki (knee) has been scratched from the lineup for the Chicago Cubs against the San Francisco Giants Sunday.
impact: Suzuki was scratched after experiencing right knee discomfort after suffering the injury in Saturday night's win, with Moises Ballesteros batting eight and replacing him at designated hitter for manager Craig Counsell against the Giants Sunday.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Ty Adcock designated for assignment
desc: The Padres have designated reliever Ty Adcock for assignment.
impact: Adcock was removed from the Padres' 40-man roster with the team recalling catcher Blake Hunt from Triple-A El Paso. Adcock has made just 11 minor league appearances for the Padres this season due to injury and owns a 5.48 ERA in 18 career outings in the big leagues.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Blake Hunt recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Padres have recalled catcher Blake Hunt from Triple-A El Paso.
impact: Hunt was recalled to take the active roster spot of fellow backstop Freddy Fermin, who was placed on the seven-day concussion injured list on Sunday. Hunt has hit .269 with one homer in eight games at Triple-A due to injury, and will make his MLB debut once he appears in a game for the Padres.
